'''September 1999 Mankato tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mankato, Minnesota (Double Play Comics) on 5 September 1999. [[Dave Kelsey]] won it. It is known from Dave Kelsey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d33">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-08-mankato-minnesota-9-5-99d33/ mankato-minnesota-9-5-99], DeckTech (Dave "IG-64" Kelsey, 8 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-08-mankato-minnesota-9-5-99d33/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 September 1999
* '''Site:''' Mankato, Minnesota (Double Play Comics)
* '''Format:''' [[Endor Draft]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Dave Kelsey]]
